market: Europe Electronic Potting and Encapsulation Compounds Market
market_definition: Electronic Potting and Encapsulation Compounds comprises liquid or paste materials dispensed around electronic assemblies and cured to protect components from moisture, vibration, chemicals and electrical stress. The scope includes epoxy, polyurethane, silicone and other compounds sold for potting or encapsulation. By Chemistry • Epoxy • Polyurethane • Silicone • Acrylic • UV-Curable By Cure Mechanism • Heat-Cure • Room-Temperature Cure • Moisture-Cure • UV-Cure By Property • Flame-Retardant • Thermally Conductive • Electrically Insulating • Flexible • Low-Stress By Application • Potting • Encapsulation • Coil and Transformer Protection • Sensor Protection By End Use • Automotive Electronics • Power Electronics • Consumer Electronics • Telecommunications • Industrial Controls By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Adhesives used only for bonding, conformal coatings applied as thin films, thermal interface materials without potting function, and complete electronic modules. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor.
